defmodule SessionManager do
  @moduledoc """
  Secure session token manager with HMAC-SHA256 authentication.
  Handles variable-length session payloads with length-prefixed encoding.
  """

  @hmac_key_size 32
  @max_payload_size 4096
  @token_version 1

  defstruct [:hmac_key, :sessions]

  def new(master_secret) when byte_size(master_secret) >= 32 do
    hmac_key = :crypto.hash(:sha256, <<"session_hmac_v1">> <> master_secret)
    %__MODULE__{hmac_key: hmac_key, sessions: %{}}
  end

  @doc "Creates a signed session token from user data"
  def create_token(manager, user_id, metadata) when is_binary(user_id) and is_map(metadata) do
    payload = :erlang.term_to_binary(%{user_id: user_id, meta: metadata, ts: System.system_time(:second)})
    payload_len = byte_size(payload)
    
    if payload_len > @max_payload_size do
      {:error, :payload_too_large}
    else
      token_body = <<@token_version::8, payload_len::signed-integer-size(16), payload::binary>>
      mac = compute_mac(manager.hmac_key, token_body)
      token = token_body <> mac
      session_id = :crypto.hash(:sha256, token) |> Base.encode16(case: :lower) |> binary_part(0, 16)
      sessions = Map.put(manager.sessions, session_id, %{created: System.system_time(:second), user_id: user_id})
      {:ok, token, %{manager | sessions: sessions}, session_id}
    end
  end

  @doc "Verifies and decodes a session token"
  def verify_token(manager, token) when is_binary(token) do
    with {:ok, body, received_mac} <- split_token(token),
         :ok <- verify_mac(manager.hmac_key, body, received_mac),
         {:ok, payload} <- extract_payload(body) do
      {:ok, payload}
    else
      _ -> {:error, :invalid_token}
    end
  end

  defp split_token(token) when byte_size(token) > 32 do
    body_len = byte_size(token) - 32
    <<body::binary-size(body_len), mac::binary-size(32)>> = token
    {:ok, body, mac}
  end
  defp split_token(_), do: {:error, :too_short}

  defp verify_mac(key, body, received_mac) do
    expected_mac = compute_mac(key, body)
    if constant_time_compare(expected_mac, received_mac) do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :bad_mac}
    end
  end

  defp compute_mac(key, data) do
    :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, key, data)
  end

  defp extract_payload(<<@token_version::8, payload_len::signed-integer-size(16), rest::binary>>) do
    # Validate payload length before extracting
    if payload_len > @max_payload_size do
      {:error, :payload_too_large}
    else
      if byte_size(rest) >= payload_len do
        <<payload::binary-size(payload_len), _padding::binary>> = rest
        case safe_binary_to_term(payload) do
          {:ok, term} -> {:ok, term}
          :error -> {:error, :corrupt_payload}
        end
      else
        {:error, :truncated}
      end
    end
  end
  defp extract_payload(_), do: {:error, :bad_version}

  defp safe_binary_to_term(bin) do
    try do
      {:ok, :erlang.binary_to_term(bin, [:safe])}
    rescue
      _ -> :error
    end
  end

  defp constant_time_compare(a, b) when byte_size(a) == byte_size(b) do
    a_bytes = :binary.bin_to_list(a)
    b_bytes = :binary.bin_to_list(b)
    Enum.zip(a_bytes, b_bytes)
    |> Enum.reduce(0, fn {x, y}, acc -> Bitwise.bor(acc, Bitwise.bxor(x, y)) end)
    |> Kernel.==(0)
  end
  defp constant_time_compare(_, _), do: false

  @doc "Refresh a token with new metadata"
  def refresh_token(manager, token, new_metadata) do
    with {:ok, payload} <- verify_token(manager, token) do
      create_token(manager, payload.user_id, Map.merge(payload.meta, new_metadata))
    end
  end

  @doc "Revoke a session"
  def revoke_session(manager, session_id) do
    %{manager | sessions: Map.delete(manager.sessions, session_id)}
  end

  def active_sessions(manager, user_id) do
    manager.sessions
    |> Enum.filter(fn {_id, info} -> info.user_id == user_id end)
    |> Enum.map(fn {id, info} -> {id, info.created} end)
  end
end
